speaker: Patient
text: 63-year-old male. The patient reports noticing a skin lesion on his chest 2 months ago, which he believes has increased in size. He denies any associated pain or itching with the lesion. He has a medical history significant for type 2 diabetes mellitus, hypercholesterolemia, and glaucoma.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Squamous Cell Carcinoma (SCC) of the Chest. Given your age, the lesion's growth over two months, lack of pain/itch, and history of diabetes, this is highly suggestive of a non-melanoma skin cancer. We will need a biopsy to confirm the diagnosis and check for local invasion.
